heading: Special provisions as to evidence relating to electronic record.
text: The contents of electronic records may be proved in accordance with the provisions of section 65B.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
